name: fsorrentino
description: Francesco Sorrentino's Claude Code plugins - currently fable-director, a delegation-efficiency director with deterministic budget enforcement.

plugins.name: fable-director
plugins.description: Keeps Claude Code from spending your quota on work the top model didn't need to do: declared pre-budgets with deterministic 2x/3x enforcement, cheap-executor routing, objective token telemetry. Small one-offs pay ~5% overhead - built for sessions that delegate.
